parameters.query:
INSERT INTO dispatch_log (
  order_id,
  unique_order_record_id,
  stock_order_id,
  date_dispatched,
  device_type,
  quantity,
  terminal_serial_number,
  cradle_serial_number,
  charger_serial_number,
  cashconnect_serial_number,
  charger_packed,
  cables,
  packer,
  stock_availability,
  pick_status
) VALUES (
  {{ $json.orderNumber }},
  {{ $json.uniqueOrderRecordId }},
  {{ $json.stockOrderId }},
  CURRENT_DATE,
  '{{ $json.deviceType }}',
  {{ $json.quantity }},
  {{ $json.terminalSerialNumber ? "'" + $json.terminalSerialNumber + "'" : "NULL" }},
  {{ $json.cradleSerialNumber ? "'" + $json.cradleSerialNumber + "'" : "NULL" }},
  {{ $json.chargerSerialNumber ? "'" + $json.chargerSerialNumber + "'" : "NULL" }},
  {{ $json.cashConnectSerialNumber ? "'" + $json.cashConnectSerialNumber + "'" : "NULL" }},
  '{{ $json.chargerPacked || "No" }}',
  '{{ $json.cables || "No" }}',
  '{{ $json.packer }}',
  '{{ $json.stockAvailability }}',
  '{{ $json.pickStatus }}'
) RETURNING id;

meta.notes: Supabase version - Replace YOUR_SUPABASE_POSTGRES_CREDENTIAL_ID with your Supabase connection. Stock availability is normalized: 'In Stock' -> 'Available', 'Out of stock' -> 'Not Available'. Pick status is normalized: 'Picked in full' -> 'Picked'.
